headline.text: L1 S3 held on *two* magnetic metal fragments found in chocolate — X-ray caught both, metal detector missed. Pecan lot suspected; line running with alternate lot staged.

summary: Two active metal-in-product events at L1 S3 — both magnetic fragments passed metal detector but caught by X-ray. L3 Truffle wire mesh broke during reheat, repaired three times. L3 ML4 reject system allowing unfilled bars through to packaging, manual monitoring now in place. L2 Panning allergen test failed after cleaning; re-clean complete.

food_safety.title: Metal fragments in chocolate — metal detector bypass
food_safety.summary: Two magnetic metal fragments found embedded in chocolate at S3 Matrix 3; X-ray rejected both, but metal detector did not detect — suspected welding slag from pecan lot 26635-N.
food_safety.status: Open — line running on lot 26635-N with alternate lot 26632-N staged; agreement to switch lots if third hit occurs within 8 hours.

food_safety.title: Truffle enrober wire mesh broke during reheat
food_safety.summary: Wire mesh broke in three places due to excessive chocolate buildup during reheat cycle; mesh repaired (not replaced) and line restarted after extended downtime.
food_safety.status: Resolved — mesh repaired, line running; no broken pieces found in production area; two spare meshes ordered.

food_safety.title: MF Matrix cone weld cracking
food_safety.summary: Feed cone weld cracking noted as contamination risk if metal particles break off during operation.
food_safety.status: Resolved — cone replaced by maintenance; area inspected, no broken pieces found.

food_safety.title: ML4 cleaning roller missing bolt
food_safety.summary: Cleaning roller 1 discovered missing tension bolt/screw during downtime inspection — potential metal contamination if bolt fell into product zone.
food_safety.status: Resolved — bolt from unused roller installed as replacement; no debris found in production area.

food_safety.title: Unfilled bars bypassing ML4 reject system
food_safety.summary: Bars missing caramel or vanilla creme reaching packaging at ML4 — Theegarten reject photo-eye timing fault allows spaced bad bars to pass when stopper disabled.
food_safety.status: Open — manual operator stationed at demolding to trigger reject when WDS light activates; TG support ticket submitted.

quality.title: FFS web tracking malfunction — extended downtime
quality.summary: Web tracking and HMI both active simultaneously causing line stoppage; Syntegon remote support engaged, issue unresolved after 90+ minutes.
quality.status: Open at window close — Ray Garcia contacted Syntegon, Dave Ruff on hold with US support.

sanitation.title: Panning sorter allergen test failure
sanitation.summary: Allergen test failed on sorter hopper, long conveyor, and short conveyor after cleaning; equipment re-cleaned.
sanitation.status: Resolved — equipment re-cleaned and passed second allergen verification.

opportunities.text: Consider metal detector sensitivity audit on S3 jar line — today's two magnetic fragments passed MD but were caught by X-ray, suggesting MD threshold may need adjustment.
Review Panning cleaning procedure for sorter belts and hopper — today's allergen test failure suggests residue persisting after standard clean.
Consider adding Truffle enrober wire-mesh inspection to weekly PM checklist — today's three-point failure during reheat suggests fatigue from buildup accumulation.
Consider adding cleaning-roller hardware inspection to ML4 startup checklist — today's missing bolt echoes similar fastener issues on this line in recent weeks.
